$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/dependency-audit.mjs (npm audit --omit=dev, high/critical). Every entry needs a reason that explains why the advisory is not reachable in production and an expiry date; an expired entry fails CI again so it gets re-reviewed. Remove entries once `npm audit` no longer reports them.

entries.reason: postcss is pulled in by Expo SDK 54's Metro bundler and only runs at build time on developer machines and EAS; the backend never loads it and no untrusted CSS is processed. Fixed upstream by the Expo SDK 55+ upgrade, which is a coordinated task.
Same Expo/Metro build-time chain as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q: source-map auto-loading only affects the developer bundler, not the shipped app or the backend. Cleared by the Expo SDK 55+ upgrade.

image-size is used by Metro/React Native asset resolution at bundle time on developer machines and EAS only; inputs are our own committed assets, never user uploads. Cleared by the React Native/Expo SDK upgrade.
Same Metro bundle-time chain as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq; ICNS parsing of our own committed assets only. Cleared by the React Native/Expo SDK upgrade.

mysql2 ships inside the Prisma 7 CLI bundle but is never loaded: the backend uses Postgres through @prisma/adapter-pg, and the CLI runs only for migrations/validation in CI and locally. Waiting on a Prisma 7.x release that drops or upgrades it.
deepmerge-ts is used by @prisma/config to merge our own prisma.config.ts at CLI start; there is no untrusted or recursive input. Waiting on a Prisma 7.x release with the patched dependency.

Denial of service via an oversized array index in field names. The API exposes no multipart or file-upload route: apps/backend/src contains no FileInterceptor, FilesInterceptor, UploadedFile or multer import, so multer is installed by @nestjs/platform-express but never wired into a request path, and multipart parsing is unreachable. Not fixable by a version bump: @nestjs/platform-express pins multer to an exact 2.2.0 in every release up to and including 12.0.1, and an npm overrides entry is silently ignored by npm 10.9 in this workspace (verified 2026-09-09). Remove once NestJS ships a release depending on multer >= 2.3.0.

Denial of service via a file descriptor leak on aborted uploads. Same unreachable chain as GHSA-535w-7cp7-47q4: no upload route exists, so no upload can be aborted. Same blocked upgrade path. Remove once NestJS ships a release depending on multer >= 2.3.0.

Denial of service via crafted multipart field names. Same unreachable chain as GHSA-535w-7cp7-47q4: no route parses multipart bodies. Same blocked upgrade path. Remove once NestJS ships a release depending on multer >= 2.3.0.
